skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator (LCD) for unlike fractions and converting them to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer/whole parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of proper or improper fractions with the same denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing from whole number
skills.definition: Regrouping by borrowing from the whole number part to add to the fractional part to resolve a negative fraction difference.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the resulting fraction part to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert unlike fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate and subtract the whole number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers or fractions.

skills.name: Regroup and borrow from whole parts
skills.definition: Borrow 1 or more from the whole number part and add the equivalent fraction to the fractional part to resolve negative differences.

skills.name: Handle whole number operands
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers as mixed numbers (whole + 0/d) to perform subtraction with fractions or mixed numbers.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the fractional result to its lowest terms by dividing the numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions once they share a common denominator.

skills.name: Unlike Denominators Conversion
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer/whole-number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from the whole-number part when the fraction subtraction results in a negative value.

skills.name: Simplifying/Reducing
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms or converting fractions with zero numerators to integers.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions with unlike denominators to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions when they share a common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Perform subtraction on the whole-number components of mixed numbers or integers.

skills.name: Regroup whole to fraction (Borrowing)
skills.definition: Borrow one or more units from the whole-number component and convert them into an equivalent fraction to resolve a negative fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fractional part of the answer to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Unlike Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.

skills.name: Whole and Fraction Separation
skills.definition: Decomposing mixed numbers or whole numbers into separate whole-number and fractional parts to perform operations independently.

skills.name: Borrowing from Whole Numbers
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing a unit from the whole-number part and converting it into a fraction when the fractional difference is negative.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms or converting a fraction into an integer/whole number.
